verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail confirms an API exists, but access is by request only and no public documentation describes API keys, tokens, or scoping. Nothing shows the user can issue scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Account 2FA is a related login control, not credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
